Strong grid and compact labels distinguish providers and email entry at a glance. Palette #ffffff #171717 #c43128 #e5e6e8. Only allowed text strings: SHOWOFF, 01 ACCOUNT, 02 WORKSPACE, 03 TEAM, SIGN IN TO SHOWOFF, Continue with Google, Continue with Apple, OR, Email, Password, Continue, Create account, NEXT, Set up your workspace, Add your team. No other copy, labels, claims, names, data or numbers. No imaginary session or organization. Keep all interface text legible. The subject is sign-in. No decorative imagery, no gradients, no content cards, no fake SaaS dashboard. Make it visibly distinct from a paper form by using a strict ruled modular screen grid and compact navigation. Professional, accessible web application interface.
